mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level is inversely related to equity returns: higher rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of all market observations.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 320, it indicates elevated inflation, which triggers a negative market reaction and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 320.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 320) creates a 'stagflation' regime that predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 320.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by GDPC1 > 23500 and UNRATE < 4.0), the S&P 500 is vulnerable to negative returns due to overvaluation and impending monetary tightening, predicting negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 23500 and UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a deteriorating labor market, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of employment (PAYEMS) is positively correlated with equity returns: higher employment levels indicate a strong labor market, which supports corporate earnings and predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of all market observations.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of real GDP (GDPC1) is positively correlated with equity returns: higher GDP levels indicate a strong economy, which supports corporate earnings and predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of all market observations.
